members.name: date
members.doc: A point in time, as a Date or epoch milliseconds. Points must be in ascending order.

members.name: label
members.doc: Short label printed beside the marker, such as "v2 launch".

members.name: description
members.doc: Longer note for the tooltip and screen readers.

types.name: BrushChartProps
types.doc: Use a brush chart for a long, dense time series where people need the whole history and a close look at any stretch of it.

members.name: label
members.doc: What is measured, such as "Daily active users". Names the chart for assistive technology.

members.name: unit
members.doc: Unit after each value, such as "users".

members.name: formatTick
members.doc: Formats the value axis. Defaults to a compact number, such as 12K.

members.name: formatDate
members.doc: Formats a date in the tooltip and announcements.

members.name: annotations
members.doc: Events drawn as markers on both charts.

members.name: range
members.doc: Controlled window as [start, end] epoch milliseconds. A new value glides the window there.

members.name: defaultRange
members.doc: Initial window when uncontrolled. Defaults to the whole series.

members.name: onRangeChange
members.doc: Called while the window is dragged, resized, stepped, or reset.

members.name: minSpan
members.doc: Smallest window in milliseconds. Defaults to seven days.
